title: QueryMsg
description: QueryMsg defines the messages that can be queried from the contract to get information.

oneOf.description: GetData returns the last Solana data that was successfully published (consensus has been reached).
GetAum calculates and returns the current Jupiter AUM value represented in BTC. Returned value is a decimal integer with precision of `WBTC_DECIMALS` Returns error if data is not valid.
GetRoundInfo returns round info that is needed for messengers to know when to publish data
Config returns the current contract configuration.
